quest.title: Treatment on the Island
quest.description: The traveling doctor Yasumoto is currently wandering Yashiori Island, urgently seeking outside help...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Hero's Wit x3, Mora x30000

dialogues.speaker: Yasumoto
dialogues.text: Yeargh!!! I'm... I'm nobody suspicious, I swear! Just a local doctor!

dialogues.speaker: Yasumoto
dialogues.text: If you don't believe me, I can take you to my place. If you want anything, take it. Please just let me go!

dialogues.speaker: Yasumoto
dialogues.text: Or take me to your General, Lord Kujou! H—He knows me!

choices.text: I think there's been a misunderstanding...

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: Huh...? Oh, you don't look like someone from the Shogunate... or from Sangonomiya.

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: Are you... an outlander? What are you doing here?

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: Well, anyway, you'd better leave here as soon as possible. Yashiori Island is very dangerous now.

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: So far, there is no sign that the Tatarigami will disappear, and the Tenryou Commission is not going to withdraw any time soon.

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: The island is no longer inhabitable, let alone suitable for sightseeing.

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: If you're fleeing arrest by the commissioner, head west.

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: The Tenryou Commission does not welcome unknown fugitives. But the pirates might take you in.

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: Hmm... Have a look for yourself. See what the city folks and Sangonomiya's people have done to us!

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: First, it was the explosion in Tatarasuna. The sky was stained with strange colors that night...

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: Many of my relatives and friends lost their jobs and now live in poverty. Many others were badly injured, and they were terrible to look upon when they finally returned home.

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: Many of my friends... didn't manage to escape.

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: Then, Sangonomiya's people destroyed the wards which suppressed the Serpent's remains. The Tatarigami arose and everyone on the island fled in a panic.

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: The strange diseases brought by the Tatarigami are also spreading. Many of the residents here have become very ill.

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: I'm afraid it's just a matter of time before it spreads to the camps of both armies.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Where am I?

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: This was one of the key places where the crystal used in making Inazuman Jade Steel was produced. As long as the crystal didn't run out, we could live comfortably without being constrained by the city folk.

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: And now? You can barely find anyone alive on the island... I mean, like me, humans who can speak normally.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Why don't you leave?

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: You think I don't want to leave? That son of the Tenryou Commissioner has invited me before... he should still be in the army overseeing the battle.

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: "You have medical skills, you are different from ordinary people. It's dangerous for you to stay on the island. Why don't you come to be my medic? I can refer you to my father."

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: That's what he said, at least.

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: Before the war, being able to treat a commissioner was an honor that I, as a countryside doctor, would never have dreamed of.

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: But now... Think about it. The commissioner wouldn't lack for good doctors around his person. But what about Yashiori Island? The only person the sick here can count on is me.

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: So I'm not going to leave. I won't treat either side of the battle. My only enemy is the Tatarigami.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Is there anything I can help you with?

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: No, nothing... Actually, forget that. Yes, to be quite honest, I really need some help.

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: I need some special plants to make medicine for treating the strange diseases caused by the "Tatarigami". I can't say it'll work for sure, but it can't hurt to try.

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: Problem is... the plants I need have been contaminated by the "Tatarigami," and they're mostly distributed in dangerous environments.

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: If they're not cut off by water, the surrounding area is crawling with monsters... not to mention that the Tatarigami is particularly intense around these parts...

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: For someone of my level of courage and ability, it'd be tough to handle it.

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: And as a doctor, I dare not take that kind of risk to collect some plants. So I've had to resort to slow-acting, cautious treatments, and haven't had the chance to test out any improved remedies in a long time.

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: Outlander, I see you've brought a wind glider with you. You must be an experienced traveler. I'm sure you'll be able to deal with dangers like this.

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: So, I hope you can help me gather the right ingredients in these locations.

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: Come meet me here once you've gathered the plants. Don't worry about the reward. I still have some savings.

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: Although it's an assignment given by a stranger, I hope you will consider it. Thank you very much.

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: By the way, please be careful on your way.

dialogues.speaker: Yasumoto
dialogues.text: Oh, you're here.

dialogues.speaker: Yasumoto
dialogues.text: Have you gathered the herbs I mentioned?

dialogues.speaker: Yasumoto
dialogues.text: Yes, yes, the stems and leaves are all intact. And they are still fresh... Thank you very much.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's all, right?

dialogues.speaker: Yasumoto
dialogues.text: Good, yes. That's enough. Now, I can start researching some new remedies.

dialogues.speaker: Yasumoto
dialogues.text: Thank you again for your effort. Here is the reward I promised you. I hope it's not too paltry a sum for you.

dialogues.speaker: Yasumoto
dialogues.text: By the way, outlander...

dialogues.speaker: Yasumoto
dialogues.text: Ah, excuse me. I have troubled you so much, but I still don't know what to call you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #Just call me {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Yasumoto
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, if you are interested in helping me again, please come back later.

dialogues.speaker: Yasumoto
dialogues.text: Of course, I'll compensate you fairly. Haha.

talks.objective: Wait till 18:00 – 21:00 the next day and talk to Yasumoto

dialogues.speaker: Yasumoto
dialogues.text: Blarghhh!! Ahem... ha... ha...

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: Well... ahem, it tastes bitter and my tongue has gone numb. Local paralysis might be caused by the Tatarigami.

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: It tastes horrible. But seems harmless.

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: It may take a long time to observe the side effects of the medicine. I don't know... Hey?

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: #They... They're coming toward us! {NICKNAME}! Get rid of them!

dialogues.speaker: Yasumoto
dialogues.text: Phew... Phew... My heart almost jumped out. Thank you for saving my life. I won't forget it.

dialogues.speaker: Yasumoto
dialogues.text: This is a normal phenomenon. Living beings affected by Tatarigami will be unconsciously attracted to inauspicious energy.

dialogues.speaker: Yasumoto
dialogues.text: Because this remedy is saturated with Tatarigami energy, it's normal that it would attract them.

dialogues.speaker: Yasumoto
dialogues.text: Phew, anyway... I think I know how to improve this remedy now.

dialogues.speaker: Yasumoto
dialogues.text: But the last failure wasted some fresh herbs. I need some more herbs to continue with my new remedy evaluations.

dialogues.speaker: Yasumoto
dialogues.text: #In your upcoming journey, {NICKNAME}, please watch out for any useful herbs on the island. Just leave them in the bamboo basket in front of the house in the mornings.

dialogues.speaker: Yasumoto
dialogues.text: I will give you the reward as I've promised. But I'm afraid you'll have to wait a while.

dialogues.speaker: Yasumoto
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, it's fine if you're busy. Maybe I can find someone else to help.

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: #Goodbye, traveler {NICKNAME}. I hope you will have a safe journey on Yashiori Island.

choices.text: Sure, I'll take care of it.

dialogues.speaker: Yasumoto
dialogues.text: #Thank you, {NICKNAME}. I'm sorry if I've caused you any inconvenience.

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: I have mixed a new remedy with the herbs you gathered. But I don't have any test subjects to assess the efficacy of the medicine.

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, can you please...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Please tell me straight-forward.

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, can I ask you to witness the efficacy of my new remedy?

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: The new prescription is still unstable and there's no way to foresee the worst consequences.

response.speaker: Yasumoto
response.text: So I hope at least someone can witness my success... Or help me deal with the consequences, if the worst comes to the worst.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Alright.

dialogues.speaker: Yasumoto
dialogues.text: Thank you very much for your help. But please be careful on Yashiori Island... This is not a safe place to stay.
